verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say it issues both physical and virtual cards with attached controls. Instant virtual cards with per-vendor limits are documented, and funds enforce amount and interval limits, so the core of the story is delivered. Not every element is evidenced, though: missing for 10: documented evidence that physical cards can be issued 'in minutes' (only virtual cards are described as instant), explicit per-card spend limits on physical cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the issuance speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue physical and virtual corporate cards to the team in minutes, each with its own spend limit

citations.quote: Issue cards, attach controls, and watch spend in real time — physical for employee in-person spend, virtual for reusable payment details
A finance team issues instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits
A budget with restrictions — amount, interval (daily, monthly, total), allowed merchant categories, allowed merchants, allowed countries.
Create custom virtual cards and set permissions for everything from ad marketplace spend to remote work stipends, for individual teams or your whole company.
